summaries.en: Following the collapse of US-Iran ceasefire negotiations, the Israeli military Chief of Staff ordered the IDF to enter the "highest level of alert" and prepare for renewed hostilities with Iran, initiating full combat readiness, including updating strike targets within Iran.
summaries.zh: 在美国与伊朗停火谈判破裂后，以色列军队总参谋长命令以军进入“最高警戒状态”，为与伊朗恢复敌对行动做准备，并启动了包括更新伊朗境内打击目标在内的全面战备程序。
